Ten exact legacy entries are additionally retained below assets/rotp_sg/legacy_archive for provenance; only the registered Arrivederci OGG also has an active exact copy.

converted_geometry.conversion: Legacy camelCase bones renamed and reparented to the current humanoid Stand anchor contract; torso_lower added; per-face UVs reproduce the core Gecko loader's donor box-UV face mapping.

converted_animation.conversion: Legacy bone targets and action clip names renamed to current moveset aliases; collapse-driving held summon keys use the donor final H1 torso/limb pose under current runtime timing; a looping wall_climb clip targets only validated H1 Stand bones; heavy_charged is built from heavy_punch (charge into the pulled-back pose, WINDUP hold loop, the original swing as PERFORM) so the charged heavy no longer plays the swing while charging.
